sourceTitle: Previous Project: Static to Dynamic QRIS Migration
excerpt: Prior QRIS migration required explicit QR expiry, duplicate payment prevention, reversal handling, settlement reconciliation, and merchant notification requirements before architecture review.
Merchant limit changes previously needed maker-checker approval, audit trail, effective date, rollback behavior, and clear ownership of limit source of truth.

sourceTitle: Incident Pattern: Payment Timeout Reconciliation Gap
excerpt: Past payment timeout incidents were caused by unclear retry ownership and missing reconciliation SLA. Requirements should identify retryable operations, timeout windows, final-state reconciliation, and manual operations fallback.

Payment requirements must specify expected TPS, peak TPS, latency target, availability target, audit events, security classification, timeout behavior, retry policy, reversal flow, and reconciliation reporting.

Previous UAT cycles often found ambiguity around pending, failed, expired, reversed, and settled statuses. Requirements should define each status, transition trigger, user-facing message, and operational handling.
